updates.title: Strict QA findings remediated
updates.changed: Resolved the strict QA findings that affected live-call usability and accessibility. Closed mobile navigation is no longer keyboard-focusable, natural caller-language search now routes key support phrases more reliably, long Call Guides use progressive disclosure without removing approved content, avatar selection and process tabs have efficient keyboard behavior, form errors identify their fields, dialogs prevent background scrolling, and the active navigation item is announced to assistive technology. Supabase hardening also removed unintended client execution of an internal SECURITY DEFINER helper, moved citext out of the exposed public schema, optimized RLS auth checks, and added missing foreign-key indexes.
checks: On tablet/mobile widths, keep the sidebar closed and confirm keyboard focus stays on visible controls; open it and confirm navigation becomes available.

Open a long Call Guide and confirm only the first set of steps, scripts, and very long callouts are shown initially, with Show remaining controls preserving access to all approved content.
Use keyboard-only navigation in the avatar picker and process tabs, and confirm validation errors identify the relevant form field.
Open a process/profile/training/report dialog and confirm the page behind it does not scroll.

updates.title: Final QA gate and landmark accessibility cleanup
updates.changed: Completed the pre-revamp release QA gate. Removed the nested main landmark from the Navigator, expanded the permanent Smart Search acceptance matrix, and added regression checks for visible keyboard focus, narrow and zoomed layouts, reduced motion, responsive navigation, and search-suggestion clipping.

updates.title: Privacy-safe usage, presence, and feedback administration
updates.changed: Connected the existing analytics tables to the Support Console. Authenticated sessions now heartbeat roughly once per minute, active time stops after five minutes without interaction, stale presence is treated as offline, Usage Analytics includes zero-usage users with Daily/Weekly/Monthly/Custom views, and the Feedback Queue now supports audited status changes plus Open Page routing. Production CI also moved to Node 24 for compatibility with the current Supabase packages.
checks: Sign in, use the Navigator, and confirm Admin Usage Analytics begins showing privacy-safe activity without storing search text, notes, clipboard content, or customer form values.
Leave the Console untouched for more than five minutes and confirm the account becomes Idle rather than continuing to accumulate active time; stale heartbeat records should display Offline.
In Usage Analytics, switch between Daily, Weekly, Monthly, and Custom and confirm every team member remains listed even when they have zero events.
In Feedback Queue, change a report status and confirm its history is recorded, then use Open Page to return to the stored process or safe Console page.

updates.changed: Extended the sidebar vertical-space protection to every browser width. When the window is wide but vertically short, the navigation list now owns the scrolling space while the console metadata and Logout remain anchored and readable instead of being pushed below the viewport.

updates.title: Workspace now follows browser window resizing progressively
updates.changed: Improved responsive behavior so the support workspace reflows in stages as the browser window becomes narrower instead of waiting for one mobile breakpoint. The Navigator main columns stack on compact desktop, category cards and workflow steps reduce from multiple columns as space tightens, and the mobile sidebar still switches to the off-canvas drawer at tablet widths.

updates.changed: Search now normalizes case, apostrophes, punctuation, and spacing; understands controlled support aliases and synonyms; tolerates close typos; shows suggestions from short prefixes; keeps the list to six results; keeps the dropdown fully visible; and opens the exact process selected.
